conclusion: HKLM IFEO cannot be written from this non-elevated session, so arming a watchpoint before the first instruction remains out of reach with the current tooling.
why_recorded: The HKCU attempt had already failed to fire, and this records that the conventional HKLM route is blocked by permissions rather than by technique. Together they close the IFEO option without leaving system changes behind.
